notes.title: Rear Loader Overhaul | AI Helper | Tipper

notes.title: BIG UPDATE | Input System Overhaul | Front Loader Overhaul | Controller Support
notes.content:
[b]This update should resolve all input system issues! The KeyBind system and Input system are overhauled! Controller Support is added! In the discussions tab I linked the Discord Server![/b]

[b]Updates:[/b]
-Added Hydraulic Cylinders to Front Loader
-New Input System allowing controllers
-New Rebind System
-Map Nature assets updated
-Added Fog(Will be optional next update)
-Updated Options Menu
-Implemented Option Menu and Rebind Menu in Front Loader Game Level
-Fixed Blade Sound
-Adjusted Front Loader Physics
-Added different dumpster sizes(New dumpster models are being implemented next update)
-Fixed Grip on SIdeLoader
-SideLoader driving controls are compatible with new Input System(Claw Controls will be added next update)
-Added automatic transmission gears
-Reduced blade speed
-Added option to toggle dumpster lids
-Adjusted dumpster lid physics
-Added Time Of Day Slider in Front Loader Level
-Adjusted BullDozer to move slower(Gives you more time to dump)

[b]There is too much added for me to remember it all but once again, thank you all for the feedback! If you run into any issues, the discussion tab has a link to the discord![/b]

[b]Next update:[/b]
-Side loader overhaul
-Controls Guide Menu
-Toggle Cursor Option
-City Map

notes.title: Here is what's in the works for the next update!
notes.content:
[b]What's being worked on:[/b]
-New Key Bind System that will also allow Controller Support
-Completely overhauled Front Loader Truck(This will include better interior view, Optimizations, Fine Tuned Physics, Implementation with the new KeyBind System)
-Fine Tuned Side Loader Physics(I will work on a overhaul after this update)
-Better dumpster lid physics and the option to toggle them on and off
-Different Sized dumpsters
-Instead of multiple maps with different time settings it will be one map and you can adjust the time in game
-City Map

[b]Whats planned after the next update:[/b]
-Side Loader Over Haul(The arm design will and hopper will be completely redesigned)
-Side Loader will have key bind implementation
-Power Lines and obstacles above dumpsters
-EXP system(This will be implemented for future use down the road)
-If time allows a Shop where you can spend money earned

[b]Thank you all for the patience, I have really been wanting to overhaul some main features for a while now![/b]

notes.title: Graphics and Map Overhaul
notes.content:
[b]Overhauled Graphics are here![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45417781/f8df94082b197ba932cb0ee6d34c4e5ce2a67723.png[/img]

A new map was built for the support of the upcoming sideloader truck! In the future the map will have a small city as well! Currently the map is based in an Island Resort with a small town in the center!

notes.title: Truck Optimizations, More Detail Added to Map, More Sounds!
notes.content:

notes.title: Career Mode is OUT!
notes.content:
[b]Whats been changed: [/b]
-A county map with commercial aspects has been added
-Ability to Enter/Exit Vehicles(You can also use the ladder on the garbage truck)
-Economy System with buyable items/upgrades
-A driveable pickup truck
-Buyable Routes(Residential and Commercial)
-An animated landfill with a bulldozer that pushes trash
-An in game Update News Section
-Ability to pick up trash while out of Vehicle
-More that I most likely forgot!

[b]Thank you all for the patience! Together with your feedback we will build a great Game![/b]

notes.title: Career Mode to Release Wednesday!
notes.content:
[b]What's to be added:[/b]
-Overhauled Landfill with working bulldozer(Complete)
-Career Mode(Start with a small pickup truck, unlock new routes, buy new trucks, and more!)(Complete)
-Ability to get in/out of vehicles(Complete)
-New Map that combines Residential and Commercial trash(Complete)
-Trash optimizations for performance(WIP)
-Ability to pick up trash while outside vehicle(Complete)

[b]Side Loader Garbage Truck Next[/b]
The sideloader should be fairly easy to implement, after the career mode has launched I will double down on implementing the vehicle! The time-consuming aspect of the side loader will be fine tuning the physics and modeling the back of the truck.
